prompt: A freight carrier in Indiana runs 20 Class 8 tractors on regional routes under 250 miles a day, about 60,000 miles per truck per year. Should it replace them with battery-electric tractors? Compute a 7-year total cost of ownership per truck for diesel vs battery-electric: purchase price, any federal and Indiana incentives that actually apply to a purchase in 2026, fuel/energy cost per mile (Indiana diesel price vs Indiana commercial electricity rate), charging infrastructure, and maintenance. Show the table, state every assumption, cite every figure with its date, and give a recommendation. Deliver a Word (.docx) memo of at most 2 pages.
